#Setup environment

```{r}
#library(readr)
#library(tidyverse)
#library(vegan)

axial_18S_ASV_FinalProduct <- read_csv("~/R/Axial2023/datainput/axial_18S_ASV_FinalProduct.csv")

tax <- read.delim("~/R/Axial2023/datainput/taxonomy.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

ASV <- read.delim("~/R/Axial2023/datainput/clean_ASV.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

samplestokeep_updated <- read_csv("~/R/Axial2023/datainput/axial_samplestokeep_updated.csv")

axial_allsamples_wReps <- read_csv("~/R/Axial2023/datainput/axial_allsamples_wReps.csv") 

axial_allsamples_wReps <- axial_allsamples_wReps %>% 
  mutate(DepthCat_wReps = paste(DepthCat_Location, REP, sep = "-"))

#Metadata without Major samples
axial_sequenced_metadata <- samplestokeep_updated %>% 
  filter(grepl("AXIAL_23", Sample)) %>% 
  filter(!depth_category %in% c("oxycline", "euphotic")) %>% 
  mutate(
    sample_loc_depth = case_when(
      depth_category == "above vent" ~ "Above Vent",
      depth_category == "diffuse" ~ "Diffuse Vent",
      str_detect(depth_category, "plume") ~ "Water Column",
      depth_category == "background" ~ "Background",
      depth_category == "30m above" ~ "Water Column",
      TRUE ~ depth_category),
    sample_name = case_when(
      sample_name == "SoupyBSW" ~ "Caldera Basin Water",
      sample_name == "IntlDist" ~ "International District",
      TRUE ~ sample_name),
    depth_location = paste(sample_loc_depth, sample_name, depth, sep = "-"))

axial_sequenced_metadata <- axial_sequenced_metadata %>% 
  mutate(sample_loc_depth = case_when(
    sample_name == "Caldera Basin Water" ~ "Caldera Basin Water",
    TRUE ~ sample_loc_depth)) %>% select(-sample_type)
#Note 11.19.26: Any code below that uses sample_type, replace with sample_loc_depth


#Make sure ASV tables just have samples of interest
ASV <- ASV %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -FeatureID,
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "value") %>% 
  filter(Sample %in% axial_sequenced_metadata$Sample) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = FeatureID,
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = 0)

asv_morethan50 <- ASV %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -FeatureID,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "SEQUENCE_COUNT") %>%
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    total_reads = sum(SEQUENCE_COUNT),
    prevalence = sum(SEQUENCE_COUNT > 0),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(total_reads >= 50, prevalence >= 3)

ASV <- ASV %>% 
  filter(FeatureID %in% asv_morethan50$FeatureID)

n_distinct(asv_morethan50$FeatureID) #1911

#prep tax table
tax <- tax %>% 
  separate(
    col = Taxon,
    into = c("Domain", "Supergroup", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Genus", "Species"),
    sep = ";") %>% 
  filter(Domain == "Eukaryota") %>% 
  filter(Phylum != "Opisthokonta") %>% 
  rename(FeatureID = Feature.ID)


alv <- c("Alveolata-Ellobiopsidae", "Alveolata-Perkinsea", "Alveolata-Unknown", "Alveolata-Chrompodellids", "Alveolata-Apicomplexa")

#Curate taxonomy
tax_asv <- tax %>% 
  filter(FeatureID %in% asv_morethan50$FeatureID) %>% 
  mutate(
    Phylum = case_when(
      is.na(Phylum) ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ Phylum),
    Class = case_when(
      is.na(Class) ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ Class),
    Genus = case_when(
      is.na(Genus) ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ Genus),
    Order = case_when(
      is.na(Order) ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ Order),
    Species = case_when(
      is.na(Species) ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ Species)) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    taxonomy_collapse = paste(
      na.omit(c(
        if (Phylum != "Unknown") Phylum,
        if (Class != "Unknown") Class,
        if (Genus != "Unknown") Genus,
        if (Order != "Unknown") Order
      )),
      collapse = ";" )) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    phylum_class = paste(Phylum, Class, sep = "-"),
    taxa = case_when(
      Supergroup == "Eukaryota_X" ~ "Unknown Eukaryota",
      Class == "Cercozoa" ~ "Rhizaria-Cercozoa",
      Class == "Radiolaria" ~ "Rhizaria-Radiolaria",
      phylum_class == "Unknown-Unknown" ~ "Unknown Eukaryota",
      str_detect(phylum_class, "Unknown-Amoebozoa_XX|Tubulinea|Evosea") ~ "Amoebozoa",
      phylum_class %in% alv ~ "Alveolata-Other",
      phylum_class == "Stramenopiles-Unknown" ~ "Stramenopiles-Other",
      str_detect(phylum_class, "Discoba|Metamonada") ~ "Excavata",
      str_detect(phylum_class, "Cryptophyta|Kathablepharida") ~ "Cryptista",
      str_detect(phylum_class, "Chlorophyta|Prasinodermophyta|Picozoa") ~ "Archaeplastida",
      str_detect(phylum_class, "Apusomonada|Breviatea|Amoebozoa") ~ "Amorphea",
      str_detect(phylum_class, "Centroplasthelida|Haptophyta") ~ "Haptista",
      str_detect(phylum_class, "Nibbleridia") ~ "Provora-Nibbleridia",
      str_detect(phylum_class, "Collodictyonidae|Mantamonadidea") ~ "CRuMS",
      str_detect(phylum_class, "Telonemia") ~ "Telonemia",
      TRUE ~ phylum_class)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Domain))

table_asv <- ASV %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -FeatureID,
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "value") %>% 
  left_join(samplestokeep_updated, by = "Sample") %>% 
  left_join(tax, by = "FeatureID") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Domain))


tax_asv_metadata <- axial_18S_ASV_FinalProduct %>% 
  filter(FeatureID %in% asv_morethan50$FeatureID) %>% 
  select(-Consensus) %>% 
  left_join(tax_asv, by = "FeatureID") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Domain))

unique(tax_asv_metadata$Domain)

#Remove surface samples
tax_asv_metadata <- tax_asv_metadata %>% 
  filter(!depth_category %in% c("oxycline", "euphotic"))

tax_asv_metadata <- tax_asv_metadata %>% 
  filter(SAMPLE %in% samplestokeep_updated$Sample) %>% 
  mutate(sample_loc_depth = case_when(
    depth_category == "above vent" ~ "Above Vent",
    sample_name == "Caldera Basin Water" ~ "Caldera Basin Water",
    depth_category == "diffuse" ~ "Diffuse Vent",
    str_detect(depth_category, "plume") ~ "Water Column",
    depth_category == "background" ~ "Background",
    depth_category == "30m above" ~ "Water Column",
    TRUE ~ depth_category)) %>% 
  mutate(sample_name = case_when(
    sample_name == "SoupyBSW" ~ "Caldera Basin Water",
    sample_name == "IntlDist" ~ "International District",
    sample_name == "SoupyBSW" ~ "Caldera Basin Water",
    TRUE ~ sample_name)) %>% 
  mutate(depth_location = paste(sample_loc_depth, sample_name, depth, sep = "-"))


n_distinct(tax_asv_metadata$FeatureID) #1,418
sum(tax_asv_metadata$value) #1,698,208
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
prok_location_order <- c("Background", "Water Column", "Above Vent", "Diffuse")
euk_location_order <- c("Background", "Water Column", "Diffuse")

prok_counts <- axial_metadata_nosurface %>% 
  filter(prok > 0) %>% 
  mutate(sample_type = case_when(
    depth_category == "above vent" ~ "Above Vent",
    sample_type == "plume" ~ "Water Column",
    sample_type == "background" ~ "Background",
    sample_type == "vent" ~ "Diffuse",
    TRUE ~ sample_type
  )) %>% 
  mutate(sample_type = factor(sample_type,
                         levels = prok_location_order))

unique(prok_counts$sample_type)

#Cell counts
prok_plot <- ggplot(prok_counts, aes(x = sample_type, y = prok, color = location_name, shape = sample_type)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(fill = location_name), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "ASHES" = "firebrick2",
    "International District" = "darkcyan",
    "Background" = "goldenrod",
    "Marker 113" = "mistyrose3",
    "Marker 33" = "mediumpurple")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "ASHES" = "firebrick2",
    "International District" = "darkcyan",
    "Background" = "goldenrod",
    "Marker 113" = "mistyrose3",
    "Marker 33" = "mediumpurple")) +
   scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Background" = 22,
    "Diffuse" = 24, 
    "Above Vent" = 25,
    "Water Column" = 21)) +   
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  facet_grid(cols=vars(sample_type), space = "free", scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "", y = "Cells/ml (log)", color = NULL) +
  ggtitle("Prokaryotic Cell Abundance") + theme(legend.position = "none")

#TOC plot
```

#Alpha diversity

```{r}
#if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

#BiocManager::install("phyloseq")

library(phyloseq)

#Add DeptCat_wReps from metadata to ASV table
alpha_ASV <- ASV %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -FeatureID,
               names_to = "Sample", 
               values_to = "SEQUENCE_COUNT") %>% 
  filter(Sample %in% samplestokeep_updated$Sample) %>% 
  left_join(axial_allsamples_wReps %>% select(Sample, DepthCat_wReps), by = "Sample")

axial_allsamples_wReps <- axial_allsamples_wReps %>% filter(Sample %in% samplestokeep_updated$Sample) %>% column_to_rownames("DepthCat_wReps")

ASV_wide <- alpha_ASV %>%
  select(FeatureID, DepthCat_wReps, SEQUENCE_COUNT) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = DepthCat_wReps,
    values_from = SEQUENCE_COUNT,
    values_fill = 0)

#Phyloseq objects need to have row.names. Define row names from ASV column.
#Then transform into matrices. Metadata can be left as DF. 
asv_mat <- ASV_wide %>%  tibble::column_to_rownames("FeatureID") %>% as.matrix()
tax_mat <- tax %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("FeatureID") %>% as.matrix()

#Transform into phyloseq objects
ASV_phy = otu_table(asv_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
tax_phy = tax_table(tax_mat)
samples = sample_data(axial_allsamples_wReps)

#Final axial phyloseq object
Axial_phy <- phyloseq(ASV_phy, tax_phy, samples)

rda.bray <- ordinate(Axial_phy, method = "RDA", distance = "bray")

plot_ordination(Axial_phy, rda.bray)

#Calculate alpha diversity
axial_alpha_div <- estimate_richness(
  Axial_phy,
  measures = c("Shannon", "Chao1"))

axial_alpha_div$SAMPLE <- sample_names(Axial_phy)

axial_alpha_div <- axial_alpha_div %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sample_dont_use") %>% 
  select(-sample_dont_use) %>% 
  separate(SAMPLE, into = c("Dive", "Filter", "DEPTH_CATEGORY", "Location_Name", "Depth", "Rep"),  
    sep = "-", 
    remove = TRUE)

sample_order <- c("Near Surface", "Background", "Caldera Basin Water", "Water Column", "Above Vent", "Diffuse")

axial_alpha_div <- axial_alpha_div %>% 
  mutate(Depth = case_when(
    DEPTH_CATEGORY == "Caldera Basin Water" ~ "Caldera Basin Water",
    TRUE ~ Depth)) %>% 
  mutate(sample_type = case_when(
    Depth == "diffuse" ~ "Diffuse",
    Depth == "background" ~ "Background",
    Depth == "above vent" ~ "Above Vent",
    Depth == "euphotic" ~ "Near Surface",
    Depth == "oxycline" ~ "Near Surface",
    str_detect(Depth, "plume") ~ "Water Column",
    str_detect(Depth, "30m") ~ "Water Column",
    TRUE ~ Depth)) %>% 
  filter(sample_type != "Near Surface") %>% 
  mutate(sample_type = factor(sample_type, levels = sample_order))

#axial_alpha_div_noreps <- axial_alpha_div %>% 
  mutate(SAMPLE = paste(Dive, Filter, DEPTH_CATEGORY, Location_Name, Depth, sep = "-")) %>%  
  group_by(SAMPLE) %>% 
  summarise(
    Shannon_mean = mean(Shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_reps = n(),
    .groups = "drop")


#Shannon  
shannon <- ggplot(
  axial_alpha_div,
  aes(x = sample_type, y = Shannon, color = Location_Name)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = NA, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(shape = sample_type, fill = Location_Name),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Vent Site", values = c(
    "ASHES" = "firebrick2",
    "Marker 33" = "mediumpurple",
    "Marker 113" = "mistyrose3",
    "Caldera Basin Water" = "darkblue",
    "International District" = "darkcyan",
```

```{r}
#axial_samples <- axial_sequenced_metadata %>% filter(Sample %in% samplestokeep_updated$Sample) %>% column_to_rownames("depth_location")
axial_phy_metadata <- axial_sequenced_metadata %>% filter(Sample %in% samplestokeep_updated$Sample) %>% distinct(depth_location, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("depth_location")

axial_phy_metadata <- axial_phy_metadata %>%

rda.bray

    sep = "-",

    Depth == "diffuse" ~ "Diffuse",
    Depth == "background" ~ "Background",
    Depth == "above vent" ~ "Above Vent",
    Depth == "euphotic" ~ "Near Surface",
    Depth == "oxycline" ~ "Near Surface",
    str_detect(Depth, "plume") ~ "Water Column",
    str_detect(Depth, "30m") ~ "Water Column",
    TRUE ~ Depth)) %>% 
  filter(sample_type != "Near Surface") %>% 
  mutate(sample_type = factor(sample_type, levels = sample_order))
```

#NMDS and PERMANOVA

```{r}
#NMDS without collapsed replicates

#Compute Bray-Curtis and run NMDS

NMDS_input <- tax_asv_metadata %>% 
  select(FeatureID, SAMPLE, value) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = FeatureID,
              values_from = value,
              values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("SAMPLE") %>% 
  as.matrix() 

#Compute Bray-Curtis and run NMDS
set.seed(123)
axial_nmds <- metaMDS(NMDS_input, distance = "bray") ##Stress= 0.129

# Extract NMDS coordinates for samples
nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(axial_nmds, display = "sites"))

# Add Sample names as a column
nmds_scores <- scores(axial_nmds, display = "sites") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SAMPLE")

NMDS_metadata <- tax_asv_metadata %>% 
  left_join(nmds_scores, by = "SAMPLE")

#Plot NMDS
#install.packages("ggnewscale")
library(ggnewscale)

NMDS_plot <- ggplot(NMDS_metadata, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +

  # WATER COLUMN FIRST
  geom_point(
    data = filter(NMDS_metadata, sample_loc_depth == "Water Column"),
    aes(shape = sample_loc_depth,
        fill = depth),
    size = 3) +

  scale_fill_gradient(
    high = "darkblue",
    low = "lightblue",
    name = "Water Column Depth (m)",
    guide = guide_colorbar(reverse = TRUE)) +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +

  # NON-WATER COLUMN SECOND
geom_point(
    data = filter(NMDS_metadata, sample_loc_depth != "Water Column"),
    aes(shape = sample_loc_depth,
        fill = sample_name),
    size = 3) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Sample Location",
    values = c(
      "Anemone" = "lightgoldenrod",
      "Gollum" = "orange",
      "ASHES" = "firebrick2",
      "International District" = "darkcyan",
      "Diva" = "darkcyan",
      "Background" = "darkblue",
      "Caldera Basin Water" = "darkblue",
      "Marker 33" = "mediumpurple",
      "Marker 113" = "mistyrose3")) +

  scale_shape_manual(name = "Sample Type",
    values = c(
    "Above Vent" = 25,
    "Diffuse Vent" = 24,
    "Water Column" = 21,
    "Background" = 22,
    "Caldera Basin Water" = 23)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, stroke = 0.5)))

ggsave("~/R/Axial2023/Figures/NMDS_plot.png", plot = NMDS_plot, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 600, units = "in")

#Run PERMANOVA. 
#1. ASV table where rows = samples and columns = ASVs. This is NMDS_input
#2. Metadata table where row = sample. This looks like NMDS_metadata. Calculate BC. 

adonis_ASV <- NMDS_input %>% 
  as.data.frame()

# Metadata with Sample as rownames
adonis_metadata <- axial_sequenced_metadata %>%
  column_to_rownames("Sample")

adonis_metadata <- adonis_metadata[rownames(adonis_ASV), , drop = FALSE]

# Ensure identical order 
adonis_ASV <- adonis_ASV[rownames(adonis_metadata), ]

# Check alignment
all(rownames(adonis_ASV) == rownames(adonis_metadata)) #TRUE

setdiff(rownames(adonis_ASV), rownames(adonis_metadata))
setdiff(rownames(adonis_metadata), rownames(adonis_ASV))

# Bray-Curtis distance
bray <- vegdist(adonis_ASV, method = "bray")

# PERMANOVA
adonis_results <- adonis2(
  bray ~ sample_loc_depth,
  data = adonis_metadata,
  permutations = 9999)

print(adonis_results)
```

#Jaccard distance decay and dendogram

```{r}
library("phyloseq")

###Collapse replicates

asv_wide <- tax_asv_metadata %>% 
  select(FeatureID, SEQUENCE_COUNT, depth_location) %>% 
  group_by(depth_location, FeatureID) %>% 
  summarise(seq_avg = mean(SEQUENCE_COUNT), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = FeatureID,
              values_from = seq_avg,
              values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("depth_location") %>% 
  as.matrix() 

#Format ASV and tax table
asv_matrix <- asv_wide %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("depth_location") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -depth_location,
               names_to = "FeatureID",
               values_to = "mean_seq") %>% 
  separate(depth_location,
    into = c("location","site","depth"),  
    sep = "-") %>% 
  mutate(SampleID = paste(location, site, depth, sep = "-")) %>% 
  mutate(SampleID = case_when(
  str_detect(SampleID, "Background-1200") ~ "Background-1200",
   str_detect(SampleID, "Background-1300") ~ "Background-1300",
   str_detect(SampleID, "Background-1400") ~ "Background-1400",
  str_detect(SampleID, "Caldera") ~ "Caldera Basin Water-1535",
    TRUE ~ SampleID)) %>% 
  select(-location, -site, -depth) %>% 
  group_by(FeatureID, SampleID) %>%  
  summarise(seq_sum = sum(mean_seq)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = SampleID, 
              values_from = seq_sum, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("FeatureID") %>% 
  as.matrix()

tax_matrix <- tax %>% 
  separate(Taxon, into = c("Domain", "Supergroup", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")) %>% select(-Consensus) %>% column_to_rownames("FeatureID") %>% 
  as.matrix()

tax_table <- tax_table(tax_matrix)
ASV_table <- otu_table(asv_matrix, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

physeq_object <- merge_phyloseq(ASV_table, tax_table, axial_metadata_nosurface)

dist <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_object, method = "jaccard")

rownames(as.data.frame(as.matrix(dist)))

dist <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(dist))

  rownames_to_column(var = "SampleA") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -SampleA, 
               names_to = "SampleB")

metadata <- axial_metadata_nosurface %>% 
  filter(sample_type != "High Temp Vent") %>% 
  select(depth_location, lat, long, depth) %>% distinct() 
  

dist_df2 <- dist_scores_df %>%
  
  left_join(metadata %>% 
              select(depth_location, lat, long, depth),
            by = c("SampleA" = "depth_location")) %>%
  rename(latA = lat,
         longA = long,
         depthA = depth) %>%
  
  left_join(metadata %>% 
              select(depth_location, lat, long, depth),
            by = c("SampleB" = "depth_location")) %>%
  rename(latB = lat,
         longB = long,
         depthB = depth)

#install.packages("geosphere")
#library(geosphere)

#dist_df2 <- dist_df2 %>%
  mutate(
    horizontal_distance = distHaversine(

#distance_decay <- ggplot(dist_df2, aes(x = distance_3d, y = value)) +
```

#Chord plot Chord diagram shows the flow between a set of entities (nodes)

```{r}
#install.packages("circlize")
#library(circlize)
#library(RColorBrewer)

#Format ASV table
chord_df <- tax_asv_metadata %>%
  group_by(sample_type, taxonomy_collapse) %>%
  summarise(abundance_avg = mean(SEQUENCE_COUNT), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(sample_type),
    !is.na(taxonomy_collapse),
    abundance_avg > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type = as.character(sample_type),
    taxonomy_collapse = as.character(taxonomy_collapse))

top_taxa <- chord_df %>%
  group_by(taxonomy_collapse) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(abundance_avg), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(total, n = 45) %>%
  pull(taxonomy_collapse)

chord_df_top45 <- chord_df %>%
  filter(taxonomy_collapse %in% top_taxa)

taxa_lookup <- data.frame(
  taxonomy_collapse = sort(unique(chord_df_top45$taxonomy_collapse))
) %>%
  mutate(tax_id = as.character(row_number()))

chord_df_plot <- chord_df_top45 %>%
  left_join(taxa_lookup, by = "taxonomy_collapse")

tax_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(nrow(taxa_lookup)),
  taxa_lookup$tax_id)

#Build alist of every unique category that will appear in the chord diagram
all_sectors <- unique(c(
  chord_df_top45$sample_type,
  chord_df_top45$taxonomy_collapse))

sample_colors <- setNames(
  rep("grey80", length(unique(chord_df_plot$sample_type))),
  unique(chord_df_plot$sample_type))

grid.col <- c(sample_colors, tax_colors)

plot_df <- chord_df_plot %>%
  transmute(
    sample_type,
    taxonomy = tax_id,
    value = abundance_avg)
#Run below as one chunk or it wont work

svg("chord_diagram.svg")

circos.clear()

chordDiagram(
  plot_df,
  grid.col = grid.col,
  col = tax_colors[plot_df$taxonomy],
  transparency = 0.4)

dev.off() 
##

legend_df <- taxa_lookup %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(tax_id)) %>%
  mutate(tax_id = factor(tax_id, levels = tax_id)) %>%
  mutate(color = tax_colors[tax_id]) %>% 
  mutate(tax_wNumber = paste(tax_id, taxonomy_collapse, sep = "-")) %>% 
  arrange(as.numeric(tax_id)) %>%
  mutate(tax_wNumber = factor(tax_wNumber, levels = tax_wNumber))
  

chord_legend <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = tax_wNumber, y = 1, fill = tax_id)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Taxonomy", values = tax_colors, breaks = legend_df$tax_id) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

ggsave("chord_legend.png", chord_legend, height = 8, width = 10, dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
#install.packages("circlize")

#Filter for taxa of interest

SRH <- tax_asv_metadata %>%

top20_abovevent <- chord_df_SRH %>% 
  filter(sample_type == "Above Vent") %>%

top20_diffuse <- chord_df_SRH %>% 
  filter(sample_type == "Diffuse") %>% 
  group_by(sample_type, taxa_species) %>%
  summarise(
    overall_abundance = mean(abundance_avg),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(
    overall_abundance,
    n = 20)

top20_background <- chord_df_SRH %>% 
  filter(sample_type == "Background") %>% 
  group_by(sample_type, taxa_species) %>%
  summarise(
    overall_abundance = mean(abundance_avg),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(
    overall_abundance,
    n = 20)

top20_watercolumn <- chord_df_SRH %>% 
  filter(sample_type == "Water Column") %>% 
  group_by(sample_type, taxa_species) %>%
  summarise(
    overall_abundance = mean(abundance_avg),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(
    overall_abundance,
    n = 20)

top20_CBW <- chord_df_SRH %>% 
  filter(sample_type == "Caldera Basin Water") %>% 
  group_by(sample_type, taxa_species) %>%
  summarise(
    overall_abundance = mean(abundance_avg),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(
    overall_abundance,
    n = 20)

top20_all <- bind_rows(
  top20_abovevent,
  top20_diffuse,
  top20_background,
  top20_watercolumn,
  top20_CBW)

n_distinct(top20_all$taxa_species) #Went from 121 total to 42

taxa_lookup_top20_all <- data.frame(
    taxa_species = sort(unique(top20_all$taxa_species))) %>%
    mutate(tax_id = as.character(row_number()))

chord_df_plot <- top20_all %>%
    left_join(taxa_lookup_top20_all, by = "taxa_species")

tax_colors <- setNames(
    colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12,"Set3"))(nrow(taxa_lookup_top20_all)),
    taxa_lookup_top20_all$tax_id)

#Build alist of every unique category that will appear in the chord diagram
sample_colors <- setNames(
  rep("grey80", length(unique(top20_all$sample_type))),
  unique(top20_all$sample_type))

grid.col <- c(sample_colors, tax_colors)

plot_df <- chord_df_plot %>%
    transmute(
        sample_type,
        taxonomy = tax_id,
        value = overall_abundance)

n_distinct(top30_all$taxa_species)

#Run below as one chunk or it wont work
svg("chord_diagram_SRH.svg")

circos.clear()

chordDiagram(
  plot_df,
  grid.col = grid.col,
  col = tax_colors[plot_df$taxonomy],
  transparency = 0.4)

dev.off() 
##

legend_df <- taxa_lookup_top20_all %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(tax_id)) %>%
  mutate(tax_id = factor(tax_id, levels = tax_id)) %>%
  mutate(color = tax_colors[tax_id]) %>% 
  mutate(tax_wNumber = paste(tax_id, taxa_species, sep = "-")) %>% 
  arrange(as.numeric(tax_id)) %>%
  mutate(tax_wNumber = factor(tax_wNumber, levels = tax_wNumber))
  

chord_legend_SRH <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = tax_wNumber, y = 1, fill = tax_id)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Taxonomy", values = tax_colors, breaks = legend_df$tax_id) +
  theme_void() +

    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

ggsave("chord_legend_SRH.png", chord_legend_SRH, height = 8, width = 10, dpi = 600)
```

#RDA
```{r}
#Generate a matrix of numerical data
numerical <- axial_sequenced_metadata %>%
  select(depth_location, depth, temp, sample_name, prok) %>% 
  group_by(depth_location) %>%
  summarise(
    depth = mean(depth),
    prok = mean(prok),
    temp = mean(temp),
    .groups = "drop"
  )  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(prok))

#Make a categorical data table 
categorical <- axial_sequenced_metadata %>% 
  select(sample_loc_depth, depth_category, 
         sample_name, depth_location) %>% filter(depth_location %in% numerical$depth_location) %>% 
  distinct()
  
numerical <- numerical %>% column_to_rownames("depth_location")

standardize_numerical <- decostand(numerical, MARGIN = 2, method = "standardize")

# Combine normalized metadata with categorical data
standardize_numerical <- standardize_numerical %>% 
  rownames_to_column("depth_location")

metadata_normalized <- categorical %>% 
  right_join(as.data.frame(standardize_numerical)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "depth_location")
  
seq_wide <- tax_asv_metadata %>% 
  select(FeatureID, value, depth_location) %>% 
  group_by(depth_location, FeatureID) %>% 
  summarise(seq_avg = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = FeatureID,
              values_from = seq_avg,
              values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("depth_location") #%>%  as.matrix()


clr_asv_matrix <- data.frame(compositions::clr(seq_wide))

asv_list <- colnames(seq_wide)

# asv_list
meta_list <- rownames(metadata_normalized)
clr_list <- rownames(clr_asv_matrix)
setdiff(meta_list, clr_list)

shared_samples <- intersect(
  rownames(clr_asv_matrix),
  rownames(metadata_normalized))

clr_asv_matrix <- clr_asv_matrix[shared_samples, ]
metadata_normalized <- metadata_normalized[shared_samples, ]

all(rownames(clr_asv_matrix) == rownames(metadata_normalized))
#Large f-ratio means there is a lot of between group variance compared to within-group variance (independent variables have a greater influence on depdendent variables). Smaller f-ratios indicate the groups are similar to one another. 

rda_clr <- rda(clr_asv_matrix ~ ., data = metadata_normalized)

summary(rda_clr)

anova(rda_clr, by = "term", permutations = 9999)

```

```{r}
major_taxa <- tax_asv_metadata %>%

    "Stramenopiles-Bigyra",
    "Stramenopiles-Gyrista",

  )) %>%
  group_by(Sample, taxa) %>%
  summarise(
    sequences = sum(SEQUENCE_COUNT),
```

#CLR Heatmap

```{r}
#library(compositions)

CLR_df <- axial_metadata_nosurface

clr_asv <- tax_asv_metadata %>% 
  select(FeatureID, Sample, SEQUENCE_COUNT)

clr_matrix <- clr_asv %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = FeatureID,
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = SEQUENCE_COUNT,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("FeatureID") %>%
  as.matrix()

clr_matrix <- clr(t(clr_matrix))
clr_matrix <- t(clr_matrix)

sample_meta <- CLR_df %>%
  distinct(Sample, sample_type, depth_location, sample_name)

tax_meta <- tax_asv_metadata %>%
  filter(FeatureID %in% clr_asv$FeatureID) %>% 
  distinct(FeatureID, taxa, Species) %>% 
  mutate(Species = case_when(
      is.na(Species) ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ Species)) 

clr_tax_asv <- clr_matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -FeatureID,
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "clr"
  ) %>%
  left_join(sample_meta, by = "Sample") %>%
  left_join(tax_meta, by = "FeatureID") %>%
  group_by(taxa, Species, depth_location, sample_name) %>% #Average replicates
  summarise(avg_clr = mean(clr), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(taxa, Species) %>% 
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = unique(Species)))

clr_tax_asv <- clr_tax_asv %>% 
  filter(taxa %in% c("Stramenopiles-Bigyra", "Stramenopiles-Gyrista",   "Haptista", "Rhizaria-Radiolaria"))

ggplot(clr_tax_asv, aes(x = depth_location, y = Species, fill = avg_clr)) +
  geom_tile() +
 facet_grid(
  rows = vars(taxa),
  cols = vars(sample_name),
  scales = "free",
  space = "free") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_blank())

ggsave("~/R/Axial2023/Figures/clr_heatmap_2.png", plot = clr_heatmap_2, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 600, units = "in")

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = avg_clr
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("taxa_species")

dendro_revised <- pheatmap(
```

#ASV table & ASV level heatmap

```{r}
library(compositions)

SRAC_asv <- tax_asv %>% 
  filter(taxa %in% c(
    "Stramenopiles-Bigyra",
    "Stramenopiles-Gyrista",
    "Rhizaria-Radiolaria",
    "Alveolata-Ciliophora",
    "Alveolata-Dinoflagellata",
    "Haptista")) %>%  select(FeatureID, taxa, Genus, Species)

write.csv(SRAC_asv, file = "~/R/Axial2023/datainput/SRAC_asv.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#Filter for taxa of interest
clr_asv <- tax_asv_metadata %>% 
  filter(taxa %in% c(
    "Stramenopiles-Bigyra",
    "Stramenopiles-Gyrista",
    "Rhizaria-Radiolaria",
    "Alveolata-Ciliophora",
    "Alveolata-Dinoflagellata",
    "Haptista")) %>% 
  select(FeatureID, SAMPLE, value, taxa, Species)


#Run CLR separately for each taxa group
clr_matrix <- clr_asv %>%
  group_by(taxa) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    
    mat <- .x %>%
      select(FeatureID, SAMPLE, value) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = FeatureID,
        names_from = SAMPLE,
        values_from = value,
        values_fill = 0
      ) %>%
      column_to_rownames("FeatureID") %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    clr_mat <- clr(t(mat))
    clr_mat <- t(clr_mat)
    
    as.data.frame(clr_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("FeatureID")
    
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

#pivot back to long format and join with metadata
sample_meta <- tax_asv_metadata %>% 
  distinct(SAMPLE, sample_type, depth_location, sample_name)

clr_tax_asv_definedASV <- clr_matrix %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(taxa, FeatureID),
    names_to = "SAMPLE",
    values_to = "clr") %>%
  left_join(sample_meta, by = "SAMPLE") %>% 
  left_join(tax %>% select(FeatureID, Species), by = "FeatureID") %>% 
  mutate(Species = case_when(
    is.na(Species) ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ Species)) %>% 
  mutate(ASV_Species = paste(FeatureID, Species, sep = "-")) %>% 
  group_by(taxa, ASV_Species, depth_location, sample_name) %>%
  summarise(avg_clr = mean(clr), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(taxa, ASV_Species)

CLR_big <- clr_tax_asv_definedASV %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Stramenopiles-Bigyra")

ASV_level_big <- ggplot(CLR_big, aes(x = depth_location, y = ASV_Species, fill = avg_clr)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(taxa),
    cols = vars(sample_name),
    scales = "free",
    space = "free") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_blank())

ggsave("~/R/Axial2023/Figures/asv_level_big.png", plot = ASV_level_big, width = 12, height = 30, dpi = 900, units = "in")
```

```{r}
library(compositions)

CLR_df_selectASVs <- tax_asv_metadata %>%

species_lookup <- tax_asv_metadata %>%
  select(FeatureID, Species, value, SAMPLE) %>%

  pivot_wider(

    names_from = SAMPLE,
    values_from = value,

  ) %>%

   distinct(SAMPLE, sample_type, depth_location, sample_name)

  mutate(Species = case_when(
    is.na(Species) ~ "Unknown",

  mutate(ASV_Species = paste(FeatureID, Species, sep = "-"))

#ASV level
clr_tax_selectASVs <- clrmatrix_selectASVs %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%

  pivot_longer(
    cols = -FeatureID,

  ) %>%

  left_join(tax_meta_selectASVs, by = "FeatureID") %>%
  group_by(taxa, ASV_Species, depth_location, sample_name) %>% #Average replicates
  summarise(avg_clr = mean(clr), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(taxa, ASV_Species) %>% 
  mutate(ASV_Species = factor(ASV_Species, levels = unique(ASV_Species)))

fewerASVs_clr_heatmap <- ggplot(clr_tax_selectASVs, aes(x = depth_location, y = ASV_Species, fill = avg_clr)) +
  geom_tile() +
 facet_grid(
  rows = vars(taxa),
  cols = vars(sample_name),
  scales = "free",
  space = "free") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_blank())

ggsave("~/R/Axial2023/Figures/fewerASVs_clr_heatmap.png", plot = fewerASVs_clr_heatmap, height = 20, width = 12, units = "in")

fewerSpecies_clr_heatmap <- ggplot(clr_tax_selectSpecies, aes(x = depth_location, y = Species, fill = avg_clr)) +

 facet_grid(
```

#CLR dendrogram heatmap (old code)

```{r}
library(compositions)

CLR_df <- axial_metadata_nosurface

clr_asv <- tax_asv_metadata %>% 
  select(FeatureID, Sample, SEQUENCE_COUNT)

clr_matrix <- clr_asv %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = FeatureID,
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = SEQUENCE_COUNT,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("FeatureID") %>%
  as.matrix()

clr_matrix <- clr(t(clr_matrix))
clr_matrix <- t(clr_matrix)

sample_meta <- CLR_df %>%
  distinct(Sample, sample_type)

tax_meta <- tax_asv_metadata %>%
  filter(FeatureID %in% clr_asv$FeatureID) %>% 
  distinct(FeatureID, taxa, Species) %>% 
  mutate(Species = case_when(
      is.na(Species) ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ Species)) 

sample_type_order <- c("Background", "Water Column", "Caldera Basin Water", "Above Vent", "Diffuse")

clr_tax_asv <- clr_matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -FeatureID,
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "clr"
  ) %>%
  left_join(sample_meta, by = "Sample") %>%
  left_join(tax_meta, by = "FeatureID") %>%
  group_by(taxa, Species, sample_type) %>%
  summarise(avg_clr = mean(clr), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(sample_type = factor(sample_type, levels = sample_type_order)) %>% 
  arrange(taxa, Species) %>% 
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = unique(Species)))

clr_tax_asv <- clr_tax_asv %>% 
  filter(taxa %in% c("Stramenopiles-Bigyra", "Stramenopiles-Gyrista",            "Haptista", "Rhizaria-Radiolaria"))

library(pheatmap)

heatmap_df <- clr_tax_asv %>%
  unite("taxa_species", taxa, Species, sep = " - ") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = avg_clr
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("taxa_species")

 pheatmap(
  as.matrix(heatmap_df),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b"))(100))

ggsave("~/R/Axial2023/Figures/dendro_revised.png", plot = dendro_revised, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 600, units = "in")

mast <- tax_asv_metadata %>% 
  filter(str_detect(Species, "MAST"))
```

#Upsest plot

```{r}
taxa <- c("Alveolata-Dinoflagellata" = "cornflowerblue","Rhizaria-Radiolaria" = 
            "coral4","Alveolata-Ciliophora" = "coral", 
          "Stramenopiles-Gyrista" = "chocolate","Rhizaria-Cercozoa" = "cadetblue","Stramenopiles-Bigyra" = "aquamarine","Archaeplastida" = "firebrick4", 
          "Discosea-Unknown" = "plum4","Stramenopiles-Other" = "lightsalmon", "Amorphea" = "darkolivegreen3","Haptista" = "gold","Amoebozoa" = "lightgoldenrod",
          "Unknown Eukaryota" = "mistyrose","Telonemia" = "rosybrown","Alveolata-Other" = "peachpuff4","Cryptista" = "coral3","CRuMS" = "darkcyan",
          "Excavata" = "orchid","Provora-Nibbleridia" = "powderblue")

# Step 1: Create presence table (ASV × Location)
upset_asv <- tax_asv_metadata %>%
  group_by(FeatureID, depth_location, taxa) %>%
  summarise(present = any(value > 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(present)

unique(upset_asv$depth_location)

# Step 2: Collapse to 1 row per ASV, listing locations
upset_input <- upset_asv %>%
  group_by(FeatureID, taxa) %>%
  summarise(locations = list(unique(as.character(depth_location))), .groups = "drop") 

library(ggupset)

# Step 3: Plot
upset_updated <- ggplot(upset_input, aes(x = locations)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = taxa)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = taxa) +
  scale_x_upset(order_by = "freq", n_intersections = 30) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Number of Shared ASVs") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Shared ASVs", fill = "Taxonomy") +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color="black", size=14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", size=14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title = element_text(color="black", size=14, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color="black", size=14, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right")


ggsave("~/R/Axial2023/Figures/upset_update.png", plot = upset_updated, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 600, units = "in")

```
